_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). pelican-eggs games-steamcmd has no Day of Defeat: Source egg, so this one is built on Octail's source-engine.json (games-steamcmd custom-source-engine/egg-custom-source-engine-game.yaml, MIT licence) with the app id (232290) and game folder (dod) fixed. Octail adds the day-of-defeat-source tags, Source RCON on the game port with a generated password, the Players tab (source preset) and the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, a max players setting (-maxplayers), an optional Game Server Login Token (+sv_setsteamaccount only when one is set), generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), the say broadcast, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Day of Defeat: Source
author: panel@example.com
description: Day of Defeat: Source is Valve's team-based World War II shooter on the Source engine: Allies against Axis, capturing flags across European battlefields.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

##
#
# Variables
# STEAM_USER, STEAM_PASS, STEAM_AUTH - Steam user setup. If a user has 2fa enabled it will most likely fail due to timeout. Leave blank for anon install.
# WINDOWS_INSTALL - if it's a windows server you want to install set to 1
# SRCDS_APPID - steam app id ffound here - https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List
# EXTRA_FLAGS - when a server has extra glas for things like beta installs or updates.
#
##


## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.
"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.
"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## other flags may be needed depending on install. looking at you cs 1.6
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${EXTRA_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/srcds_run" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Day of Defeat: Source dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Game ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the Day of Defeat: Source dedicated server.

variables.name: Default Map
variables.description: The first map, for example dod_avalanche, dod_anzio, dod_donner or dod_flash.

variables.name: Steam Game Server Login Token
variables.description: Optional: a Steam Game Server Login Token (app id 300) so the server keeps the same Steam ID and shows in the server list reliably. Generate one at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Source RCON password. Octail generates one when the server is created and sends console commands over RCON.
